eng.Requirement: Microsoft 365 test tenant with custom app upload
eng.In simple words: A test tenant is a practice Microsoft 365 company, separate from real customers. Sideload means installing our app package before it is in the public Store. Teams blocks that unless Upload custom apps is turned on.
eng.What we already know: No Microsoft 365 test tenant is saved in this file. Without a tenant that allows custom app upload, the Teams package cannot be sideloaded.
eng.What is still missing: The app cannot be sideloaded or tested at all without a tenant that allows custom app upload.
eng.Easy steps:
1. If the team does not already have a test tenant, join the Microsoft 365 Developer Program with a work account and create the sandbox.
2. Write down the tenant ID from https://entra.microsoft.com  →  Overview. It will be different from the SECUREITLAB tenant.
3. Open the Teams admin centre of THAT test tenant: Teams apps  →  Setup policies  →  Global.
4. Turn Upload custom apps to On. Save. Wait if the page says it can take a few hours.
5. Screenshot the toggle set to On, and screenshot the tenant ID.
eng.When finished, change the result to: Change Result right now to Compliant only after the proof file is saved. If the steps say this does not apply, change it to Not Applicable and write the reason in What is still missing.

master.Requirement: Microsoft 365 test tenant with custom app upload
master.What to Check: A Microsoft 365 tenant is available for testing, with Teams licences and an app setup policy that allows custom app upload, so the package can be sideloaded.
master.Question / Discussion Point: Which tenant is used for testing, and is custom app upload enabled in the Teams admin centre app setup policy?
master.What to Tell / Explain: Explain that a Teams app cannot be tested at all without a tenant where sideloading is permitted. If this has not been enabled, every testing task in the plan is blocked regardless of development progress.
master.Why It Is Required: The app cannot be sideloaded or tested at all without a tenant that allows custom app upload.
master.Expected Evidence: Tenant ID; screenshot of the app setup policy showing custom app upload enabled.
